newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Asiatrust take profits - Sun Hung Kai.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Asiatrust take profits - Sun Hung Kai.

text.p: Stock brokerage Sun Hung Kai Securities on Tuesday recommended "take profits" on newly-listed Asiatrust Bank.
It said Asiatrust is the third largest among 37 local private development banks after Capitol Bank and Planters Development Bank.
At the reported grey market price of 42 pesos per share, the counter is already trading at 12 times forecast 1997 earnings, the brokerage said.
The stock made its debut at 43.50 pesos but slipped back to 39.50 pesos in the first half hour of trading on Tuesday.
The stock was offered at 39.88 pesos per share.

"The bank deserves to trade at a discount to other listed commercial and universal banks given its limited size, product lines and target market. Take profits," the Sun Hung Kai advisory to its clients said.
